worldcombat.skill.ficklebeam.summary: A thin, self-damage-free Dragon beam: usually a single strand hitting the first enemy on the line; each shot may wake all strands to fire side by side, covering a wider strip with several near-parallel lines, with total damage on one target capped at twice the base. It can also be fired in any direction or at a world point.
worldcombat.skill.ficklebeam.description: One strand deals about %1$s Dragon special damage; it reaches up to %2$s blocks with a %3$s-block half-width, needs a clear line, and each strand strikes only the first enemy on its own line, cut short at a wall.
Each shot has a %1$s chance that all light strands wake together: each walks its own near-parallel line and covers a wider strip, and total damage on one target stays within twice the base.
worldcombat.skill.ficklebeam.unison.on: Unison: +0.12 unison chance at the cost of power ×0.88 and +2 wind-up - gamble on the multi-strand volley.
worldcombat.skill.ficklebeam.unison.off: Casual: power ×1.12 and unison chance 0.06 below base, with no wind-up penalty - a steady hit.
worldcombat.skill.ficklebeam.timing: Range %1$s blocks; wind-up %2$s s, recovery %3$s s, cooldown %5$s s, %4$s PP.
worldcombat.skill.ficklebeam.growth.0: From level %1$s the beam power steps up to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.ficklebeam.growth.1: From level %1$s the beam power reaches %2$s and the unison chance rises to %3$s.
worldcombat.skill.ficklebeam.use.0: A thin, self-damage-free ranged Dragon beam
worldcombat.skill.ficklebeam.use.1: Gamble on all strands firing side by side to cover a wider strip
worldcombat.skill.ficklebeam.use.2: Wear a foe down from a distance
On: +0.12 unison chance at the cost of power ×0.88 and +2 wind-up - gamble on the doubled shot. Off (casual): power ×1.12 and unison chance 0.06 below base for a steady hit.
Above this distance the companion closes in before firing. This move costs nothing, so a larger value lets it start wearing foes down sooner.
